name: Birthday of Horrors
description:
Birthday of Horrors turns your special day into a nightmare you won’t forget. No guests, no cake—just you, a dark house, and something that really wasn’t on the invite list.

Explore a spooky, retro-style home filled with strange noises, flickering lights, and eerie surprises around every corner. It’s part horror, part comedy, and all chaos as you try to survive the weirdest birthday ever.

Search for clues, solve odd puzzles, and avoid whatever’s stalking the halls. You're not just blowing out candles—you’re trying to stay alive long enough to open a single present.
And hey, if the monster doesn’t get you, the party playlist on loop just might.
